claim: The University of Lisbon has a stand at Web Summit in Pavilion 1 from 10 to 12 November, its second year in a row.
Técnico has its own stand at Web Summit in Pavilion 2, stand E272.
Técnico brings six spin-offs to Web Summit: Acubic, Keel, Opsivision.ai, RTBEAMTECH, RipeNew and Testwaves.
The second UniVerse: Academia Empreendedora takes place on 10 November at the Portugal Pavilion Congress Centre, hosted by ULisboa.
UniVerse: Academia Empreendedora involves nine Portuguese higher education institutions.
ULisboa took first place in Startup Portugal's 2025 Ranking of Entrepreneurial Universities.

Citing Dealroom, ULisboa is the only Portuguese higher education institution with more than 1,000 alumni who have founded startups, with a combined enterprise value over 30 billion euros across 36 countries.
Four of Portugal's six unicorns come from the ULisboa ecosystem: OutSystems, TEKEVER, Talkdesk and Anchorage Digital.
Arlindo Oliveira is a professor at Técnico and president of the research institute INESC, and joins a Future of Work Summit panel.
Fundação Santander supports Técnico's participation at Web Summit.
